S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  C482 No.986 of 2023  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate, for the applicants.
Mr. Tumul Nainwal, Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand.

The instant C-482 Application has been preferred by the present applicants as against the chargesheet No. 597A/21 dated 14th May, 2022, as well as the summoning order dated 5th September, 2022, as it has been rendered by the Court of Addl.

Chief Judicial Magistrate, Laksar,
District Haridwar, calling upon the present applicants to face the trial of Criminal Case No. 559 of 2022, State Vs. Arjun and others, for the offence under Sections 406, 420, 323, 506 and 504 of the IPC.

entities.text:
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Laksar,
District Haridwar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants, candidly without venturing into the merits of the matter has submitted, and had confined his prayer, that since all the offences fall within the domain of consideration of the judgement of the Hon'ble Apex Court as reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51, Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, they may be granted liberty to surrender before the Trial Court and their Bail Application may be directed to be considered as per the guidelines framed in para 3 (e) of the said judgment in relation to 'A' category of offences.
Owing to the aforesaid principle laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court, if the applicants surrender before the learned Trial Court and seek their bail, the same would be considered as per the law.
Subject to the aforesaid, the C482 Application would stand disposed of.
